shots.name: shot-kmh
shots.caption: Your real speed on your home screen
shots.text: The big dial reads your GPS speed in km/h or mph, and a red mark keeps the top speed of the drive.
shots.alt: The wallpaper on a phone: the big speed dial at 87 km/h with battery, RAM, Wi-Fi and signal gauges

shots.name: shot-power
shots.caption: See the watts in and out
shots.text: Watts going into the battery show to the right, and watts going out to the left, with a minus.
shots.alt: Power mode: the big dial at 18.5 watts going into the battery

shots.name: shot-cpu
shots.caption: Watch the processor work
shots.text: How fast the processor runs, as a share of its top speed, on phones that allow reading it.
shots.alt: CPU clock mode on the big dial

shots.name: shot-wifi
shots.caption: Every gauge reads your phone
shots.text: Signal, Wi-Fi, RAM and battery gauges sit around the big dial, with the date and time on an LCD.
shots.alt: A fast Wi-Fi link on the Wi-Fi gauge

shots.name: shot-home
shots.caption: Set it up in one tap
shots.text: Set the wallpaper, swipe through the designs, and choose what the gauges, date, time and LEDs show.
shots.alt: The app's home screen: Set wallpaper, Designs, Settings and Info
